newsitem.title: USA: Hadco drops plans to offer notes.
newsitem.headline: Hadco drops plans to offer notes.

text.p: Hadco Corp said Tuesday it is dropping previously reported plan for a subordinated debt offering, but will go forward with an as-yet-unpriced stock offering.

Hadco said it filed an amendment to its registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with its public offerings of 2 million common shares and $100 million of convertible subordinated notes to eliminate the notes
The stock portion of the offering remains unchanged, the company said.
Robertson, Stephens & Company LLC, Merrill Lynch & Co and Adams, Harkness & Hill Inc will be managing the offering.

The company said it intends to use 80 to 100 percent of its proceeds from the offering to repay a portion of its outstanding bank debt and the rest, if any, for general corporate purposes, which may include acquisitions.
